description: The only rate limiting rule of Cloudflare Free (§6): 300 requests per 10 s per IP and data center. Free accepts only the Path and Verified Bot fields. Verified bots and immutable build assets do not count, so a shared mobile IP (CGNAT) is not blocked by page assets. Webhooks count (security review D-1): 300 per 10 s per IP is far above any provider's volume, and providers retry a 429. Finer limits live in the app (Valkey).

rules.description: Whole site: 300 requests per 10 s per IP
